source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, adhyaya 3 (Paushya parva: Uttanka, the earrings of King Paushya's queen, Takshaka, the Naga world, Uttanka at Janamejaya's court)
structure: Every episode: RECAP (≈3 s; KIT.series.recapStrip) → HOOK (one question, Sauti at the Naimisha fire; the episode title follows it: KIT.series.episodeTitle) → STORY → NEXT (a cliffhanger line, then the teaser card: KIT.series.nextTeaser).

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice, used by the timeline), say (what is spoken, if not `text`): '…' and '—' pause, ',' and '.' pause a little, [p:400] pauses 400 ms, {s:0.8} speaks what follows at 0.8× until the next {s:…} ({s} resets).

lines.text: A curse fell on King Janamejaya.
lines.note: RECAP. The Naimisha fire at night, Sauti seated by it; the series 'Previously' strip; in the smoke, Sarama's luminous profile over the king (beats[0] = 'curse')

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: Meanwhile, a student named Uttanka set out on a quest.
lines.say: Meanwhile… [p:100] a student named Uttanka set out on a quest.
lines.note: HOOK (Sauti, at the fire). The smoke becomes a road; a young student walks it. beats = 'Uttanka' (his name in gold), 'quest'; the episode title shows in the post

lines.text: His teacher's wife asked for one gift: the earrings of King Paushya's queen.
lines.say: His teacher's wife asked for one gift: [p:200] the earrings of King Paushya's queen.
lines.note: STORY 1. The teacher's hermitage at morning; the episode title rises. beats = 'wife' (she asks, hand open), 'earrings' (a vision of two glowing earrings between them), 'Paushya's'

lines.text: The queen gave them, but warned:
lines.note: STORY 2. King Paushya's palace in warm lamp-gold: the queen places the earrings in Uttanka's hands. beats = 'gave', 'warned' (she raises a finger)

lines.speaker: queen
lines.text: Takshaka, the serpent king, wants these.
lines.say: Takshaka, [p:200] the serpent king, [p:150] wants these.
lines.note: STORY 3 (the queen speaks). beats = 'Takshaka' (a cold green glint behind the lattice: a hooded shadow), 'these' (the earrings flash)

lines.text: On the way back, Takshaka stole them… and vanished underground.
lines.say: On the way back, [p:100] Takshaka stole them… [p:200] and vanished underground.
lines.note: STORY 4. The forest road at dusk: the earrings set down by a stream; a shimmering beggar snatches them, runs, and becomes the serpent king, who dives into a cleft in the earth. beats = 'Takshaka' (the beggar appears), 'stole' (the snatch), 'vanished' (the dive)

lines.text: Uttanka followed him into the serpent world, and won them back.
lines.say: Uttanka followed him into the serpent world… [p:200] and won them back.
lines.note: STORY 5. Down through the cleft into the Naga world: deep blue-green bioluminescence, hooded domes, glowing jewels. beats = 'followed' (he descends), 'world' (it opens out), 'won' (fire and smoke pour through the halls; Takshaka recoils and yields the earrings; gold flares against the green)
STORY 6. Uttanka climbs out, earrings in hand, and looks back down: his rim burns from coral to red. beats = 'anger', 'burned'
NEXT 1. Janamejaya's court at Hastinapura, the king enthroned in saffron lamplight; Uttanka strides in

lines.speaker: uttanka
lines.text: Takshaka killed your father. Avenge him.
lines.say: Takshaka killed your father. [p:350] Avenge him.
lines.note: NEXT 2 (Uttanka speaks). beats = 'killed' (a cold green hood rises in the lamp smoke over a fallen crown: Parikshit's), 'father', 'Avenge' (Uttanka points)

lines.text: The king vowed a sacrifice to burn every serpent.
lines.note: NEXT 3. The king rises and raises his hand; behind him a great fire roars up and serpent shadows writhe in it. beats = 'vowed', 'burn', 'serpent'
the teaser card (KIT.series.nextTeaser), with a glimpse of episode 7: the great fire of the snake sacrifice
